_comment: Watchdog member list. One entry per member the watchdog should keep alive. 'start' is the command used when that member is not listening (first item = executable, rest = arguments). Add a new member by adding one entry here - no script edit needed. NOTE: each member must have exactly ONE owner here - two entries for the same id fight each other, and the board then shows a member that is 'online' but answers nothing (tools/channel-lock.mjs now enforces this at runtime).

members.why: Codex 常驻通道（app-server）：必须经 cmd 启动，自启动链直接 spawn codex.exe 会 ENOENT
引擎是 codex-cli：被点名时真的产出回复并写回黑板（不再是只挂心跳的监听器）
用它自己搭的托管入口 workbuddy/run.mjs：薄封装、复用通用运行器、不复制协议（见 workbuddy/README.md）。workspace-write 是为了它真能落盘产物——只读沙箱时它只能把补丁贴在黑板上（实测 #134）
